messages:
alex: FYI dashboard alert — prefix cache coverage for goliath-13b on /chat/compose down ~14% for tenant Acme :chart_with_downwards_trend:
metrics-bot: alert fired: prefix_cache_coverage_drop (threshold 5%) — see https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/prefix-coverage?orgId=1
maria: ugh. Was there a kernel rollout last night? I saw a perf rollback on kernel-v2.1
sam: yep, kernel-v2.1 went live 03:12 UTC. Batching heuristics changed (dynamic folding). Might have affected key normalization.
jordan: +1. Keying gets fragile if batch ordering changed — we saw similar during seq-boundary change.
alex: quick check: cache_coverage{route="/chat/compose",model="goliath-13b",tenant="acme"} dropped from 62% -> 48% between 03:10-04:00 UTC
maria: that's the token-saved impact: tokens_saved_sum decreased by ~22k/hour for that tenant.
sam: hypothesis: folding changed token boundaries which changed prefex-to-key mapping. Need to confirm with profiler snapshots.
metrics-bot: profiler-snapshot created: s3://redwood-profiler/goliath-13b/4418000000/profile-03:20.tar.gz
jordan: can someone run key_diff script to compare before/after keys for a sample of requests?
alex: running now: ```scripts/key_diff --model goliath-13b --route /chat/compose --start 2026-03-17T03:00 --end 2026-03-17T04:00 --sample 1k``` results will upload to #eng-runtime
maria: also let's add tokens_saved_sum to the per-tenant panel and surface median latency — that will make regression obvious to oncall
sam: temporary mitigation: enable legacy-batching for goliath-13b on the route for Acme (roll back folding) until we fix normalizer
jordan: open PR to config repo? I'll handle: PR #842 toggles dynamic_folding=false for model goliath-13b on route /chat/compose for tenant acme
alex: action items: 1) sam to run key_diff & profiler correlate, 2) jordan PR + deploy rollback, 3) maria update dashboards & add token-saved alert, 4) ops to run targeted warmup
sam: quick note: warmup script respects shuffle seed — might need deterministic seeding after key normalizer change
maria: dashboard query I'm adding: ```sum by (tenant,route,model) (tokens_saved_sum{env="prod"}) / sum by (tenant,route,model) (requests_total{env="prod"})``` gives tokens saved per request
alex: thanks — let's sync in 30m if PR merges. :thumbsup:
